source: The exact conventions vary by runtime. Some symmetric ZXNAME0000XZ implementations intentionally use ZXMATH0000XZ instead of the full signed ZXMATH0001XZ range to preserve exact symmetry around zero.
zh: 确切的约定因运行时而异。一些对称 ZXNAME0000XZ 实现有意使用 ZXMATH0000XZ 而不是完整签名的 ZXMATH0001XZ 范围，以保持零附近的精确对称性。
